name: tssr-monitor
description: e-YAS SITES - Site Intelligence Tracking & Execution System

scripts.start: npx concurrently "npm run dev" "npx wait-on http://localhost:3000 -t 60000 && npm run electron:dev"
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('path');const nm=p.join(__dirname,'node_modules');if(fs.existsSync(nm)){console.log('Removing node_modules...');fs.rmSync(nm,{recursive:true,force:true});console.log('Done')}"
scripts.build:analyze: vite build --mode analyze && echo 'Check dist/stats.html for bundle analysis'
scripts.test: node tests/database-adapter.test.js && node tests/websocket-broadcast.test.js && node tests/batch-processor.test.js && node tests/batch-import.test.js && node tests/single-import.test.js && node tests/import-ipc.test.js && node tests/realtime-sync.test.js && node tests/calculations.test.js && node tests/report-generation.test.js && node tests/integration.test.js
scripts.test:unit: node tests/database-adapter.test.js && node tests/calculations.test.js && node tests/batch-processor.test.js
scripts.test:watch: nodemon --watch tests --watch electron --ext js --exec "npm run test:unit"
scripts.test:import: node tests/batch-import.test.js && node tests/single-import.test.js && node tests/import-ipc.test.js
scripts.test:week3: node tests/realtime-sync.test.js && node tests/calculations.test.js && node tests/report-generation.test.js && node tests/integration.test.js
scripts.test:excel: node -e "const reader = require('./electron/services/excelReader'); const sites = reader.getAllData('../TSSR Tracker Zain Jo 5.xlsm'); console.log('Total sites:', sites.length)"
scripts.dev:full: npx concurrently -n vite,server,electron -c cyan,yellow,magenta "npm run dev" "npm run server:dev" "npx wait-on http://localhost:3000 -t 60000 && npm run electron:dev"

author: Aysar
